YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! All credit to @allyssainthekitchen for this incredible recipe! 🤎 SAVE THIS ONE because I promise you’ll be making it again and again! #SundayDinner #ChickenThighs #EasyDinnerIdeas #HomeCooking #DinnerRecipes

BAKED MAC N CHEESE🧀🦃 DAY 1 of my Thanksgiving Side Dish Series! 🦃🧀 Starting off strong with my homemade Baked Mac & Cheese because you simply cannot have Thanksgiving without mac & cheese! Creamy, cheesy, and loaded with FIVE different cheeses. 🤤 Ingredients: 24 oz elbow macaroni 6 tbsp butter 6 tbsp all-purpose flour 2 cups whole milk 3 cups heavy cream 8 oz sharp cheddar, shredded 8 oz Colby Jack, shredded 8 oz medium cheddar, shredded 8 oz mozzarella, shredded 4 oz Gruyère, shredded Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp ground mustard 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp salt (or to taste) Directions: 1. Boil macaroni in salted water for about 6 minutes, just shy of al dente. Drain and set aside. It’ll finish cooking in the oven! 2. In the same pot, melt butter over medium-low heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring constantly to remove the raw flour taste without browning. Stir in seasonings. 3. Slowly whisk in milk until smooth, followed by heavy cream. Cook for 5–8 minutes, stirring frequently, until warmed through and slightly thickened. Don’t let it boil! 4. Turn OFF the heat! This is key! Adding cheese over high heat can cause the proteins to tighten and the oils to separate, leaving you with a grainy, greasy sauce instead of a smooth, creamy one. Gradually stir in HALF your shredded cheese until melted and silky. 5. Fold in macaroni until completely coated. In a greased 9x13 baking dish, layer half the macaroni, half the remaining cheese, the rest of the macaroni, and finish with the remaining cheese. 6. Bake at 350°F for 15–20 minutes until hot and melted. Keep an eye on it! For that golden, crispy cheesy top, broil on high for 2–3 minutes, watching closely. And that’s it! The perfect cheesy, creamy Thanksgiving side dish! 🧀🤎 SAVE this recipe for your Thanksgiving menu! 🦃 #bakedmac #thanksgivingrecipes #thanksgiving #sidedish #floridablogger

My sister-in-law’s famous Thanksgiving mashed potatoes 🥔 I’m also releasing a completely free Thanksgiving cookbook with recipes for every staple Thanksgiving dish you need for the big day. Everything is easy and doable without sacrificing flavor. Coming very soon, so follow my page so you don’t miss it Ingredients • 5 lb Yukon gold potatoes • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ⅓ cup sour cream • ½ cup milk • 1 stick butter, softened, plus extra slices for topping • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp salt • Paprika, for topping • 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped Instructions 1. Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Pressure cook on high for 14 minutes, then allow a 10-minute natural pressure release before releasing the remaining pressure. Carefully remove, cool slightly, and peel. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. Bake covered for approximately 60 minutes, until hot in the center. 6. Remove foil for the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 7. Sprinkle with the chopped chives before serving. #mashedpotatoes #EasyRecipe

videos.caption: Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Here's an Italian dish you might not know about. If you've never had gnudi, think of them as the soft, pillowy filling of ravioli, just without the pasta! They're traditionally made with ricotta, often with spinach, but I wanted to give them a little fall twist with roasted butternut squash. And of course, I had to finish them with brown butter and crispy sage. Butternut Squash Gnudi with Brown Butter and Sage Ingredients For the Gnudi: 1 medium butternut squash (about 2¾ lb / 1.2-1.3 kg), halved lengthwise 2 tsp olive oil Pinch of salt, for roasting 1 cup (245 g) whole-milk ricotta, drained 1 large egg ½ cup (45 g) finely grated Parmigiano-Reggiano ¾ cup (95 g) all-purpose flour, plus more for shaping and dusting ½ tsp (3g) fine sea salt  Pinch of freshly grated nutmeg For the Brown Butter and Sage Sauce: 6 tablespoons (85 g) unsalted butter, divided 10-12 fresh sage leaves ⅓ cup (30 g) finely grated Parmigiano-Reggiano 1 cup (240 ml) reserved gnudi cooking water, as needed 2-3 tbsp heavy cream, optional (see notes) Freshly ground black pepper, for serving Shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano, for serving Full recipe is on my website! #butternutsquash #fallrecipes #fall #gnudi #yarindanieli  Butternut squash gnudi, Italian fall recipes, homemade gnudi, brown butter sage sauce, ricotta dumplings

Creamy Tuscan Chicken Rigatoni 🍝 Recipe ⬇️ Juicy, perfectly seasoned chicken over rigatoni tossed in a creamy garlic Parmesan sauce loaded with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, and fresh veggies. And yes, we're pouring even more sauce over the chicken! INGREDIENTS CHICKEN + 1 lb chicken breasts + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1 tbsp garlic powder + 1 tsp Italian seasoning + 1 tsp black pepper + ½ tsp salt + 1 tbsp avocado oil PASTA + 10 oz rigatoni + ½ cup reserved pasta water, plus more as needed CREAMY TUSCAN SAUCE + 2 cups heavy cream + 1½ tbsp butter + 2 tbsp cooking oil + 1 shallot, diced + 10 garlic cloves, minced + ½ red bell pepper, diced + 12 cherry tomatoes, halved + ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped + 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan + 1 cup baby spinach + ¾ tsp chicken bouillon powder SAUCE SEASONINGS + ½ tsp smoked paprika + ½ tsp garlic powder + ½ tsp black pepper + ½ tsp Italian seasoning + ¼ tsp red pepper flakes + Salt to taste FINISHING + 1–2 tsp fresh lemon juice (optional) + Fresh parsley + Extra Parmesan DIRECTIONS + STEP 1: SEASON & SEAR Butterfly chicken into cutlets and coat with seasonings. Sear in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 3–5 minutes per side until golden and 165°F internally. Remove and rest. + STEP 2: COOK THE PASTA Cook rigatoni in salted water until al dente. Reserve pasta water before draining. + STEP 3: SAUTÉ THE VEGGIES In the same skillet, add butter, oil, shallot, and bell pepper. Cook 3–4 minutes. Add garlic, cherry tomatoes, and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook another 2–3 minutes. + STEP 4: MAKE THE SAUCE Reduce heat to medium-low. Add heavy cream, ½ cup pasta water, bouillon, and all sauce seasonings. Simmer 3–4 minutes. Reduce heat to low and gradually stir in Parmesan until smooth. + STEP 5: COMBINE Reserve ¾ cup sauce for drizzling. Add spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted. Toss in rigatoni, adding pasta water as needed. Finish with lemon juice if desired. + STEP 6: SERVE Slice chicken and arrange over the pasta. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

CREAMY LEMON BUTTER CHICKEN is the easy weeknight dinner you’ll keep on repeat.  Ingredients For the Chicken 	•	1½ lbs chicken breast (2 large breasts sliced into 4 cutlets) 	•	1–2 tsp oil 	•	½ tsp dried thyme 	•	½ tsp dried oregano 	•	½ tsp garlic powder 	•	½ tsp paprika 	•	1 tsp salt 	•	½ tsp black pepper For the Breading 	•	½ cup all-purpose flour 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	¾ cup plain breadcrumbs 	•	½ tsp dried thyme 	•	½ tsp dried oregano 	•	½ tsp garlic powder 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	1–2 tbsp neutral oil (for frying) 	•	2 tbsp butter (for frying) For the Lemon Butter Sauce 	•	5 tbsp butter 	•	4 garlic cloves, minced 	•	Juice of 1–1½ lemons (about 3–4 tbsp) 	•	1½ cups low-sodium chicken broth 	•	1–2 tsp Dijon mustard 	•	½ cup heavy cream 	•	Salt and black pepper, to taste 	•	Optional: lemon zest and chopped fresh parsley Instructions 	1.	Slice chicken breasts into 4 thin cutlets and lightly pound to even thickness. Drizzle with oil and season both sides with thyme, oregano, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. 	2.	Set up three bowls: flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs mixed with the seasonings. Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs. 	3.	Heat oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through (165°F). Transfer to a plate. 	4.	In the same pan, melt butter and sauté garlic for 30 seconds. 🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Bake: Bake for 29–30 minutes, depending on your oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 3. Poke & pour: While the cake is still warm, poke holes all over the top. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! videos.caption: Smothered Green Beans 🫛🥓🥔 FULL RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  A delicious side dish that I have to have on the table for holiday meals! Hope y’all enjoy this one 🙌🏿🔥  Ingredients:  Green Beans- ~ 44oz Petite Golden Potatoes - 24oz bag Onion- 1 Red Bell Pepper- 1 Garlic- 4 cloves Bacon- 12oz Beef Smoked Sausage- 12oz Flour- 3 tbsp Chicken Stock (low sodium)- 7 cups Chicken Bouillon- 1 tbsp Salt- 1 tbsp White Pepper- 1 tbsp Onion Powder- 1 tbsp Garlic Powder- 1 tbsp Paprika-  2 tbsp Complete Seasoning or All Purpose Seasoning (salt free)- 2 tbsp Worcestershire Sauce- 1 tbsp Hot Sauce- 2 tbsp Cornstarch (for slurry)- 1 tbsp Water (for slurry) - 1 tbsp   Method:  Prep your ingredients before you start cooking to make the process smoother includes: chopping onions, garlic and peppers, chopping up the bacon and sausage, snipping and washing green beans, and cutting the golden potatoes in half.    Cook the bacon in a big pot on medium heat while constantly stirring allowing it to cook in its own fat. Once its crispy, remove from the pan and go in with the sliced sausage cooking until crispy, then remove.    Into the same pot add the onions and peppers and cook until translucent then add in the chopped garlic and cook until fragrant. Once its cooked start a roux by adding flour and fully combining.    Slowly pour and stir chicken stock into the roux. Once fully incorporated season the gravy with the seasonings listed above along with hot sauce and worcestershire sauce.    Add in the green beans and fully combine, then cover with a lid and cook on medium for about 45 minutes. Take the lid off and add in the potatoes. Cover with a lid again for about 30 minutes or until the potatoes are fork tender.    Add the cornstarch slurry in and allow the gravy to thicken up and you should be set! Be sure to add a little salt at the end (to taste). Then add to a serving dish or directly to your plate and dig in. Enjoy!  #homecooking #holidaydishes #foodtok #fyp #easyrecipe

This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Cook chicken in a covered pan over medium heat for around 8 minutes per side until fully cooked. Set aside & shred using 2 forks. 4. In the same pan cook diced garlic in the leftover chicken juices. Warm a tortilla then add 25g grated cheese to one half, followed by 1/10 of the chicken filling & another 25g cheese. Fold over. 6. Toast in a pan on both sides until golden & crispy. Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

High Protein Crockpot Tuscan Chicken    this recipe is so easy to make and packed with protein. save this for your next meal prep 🫶🏽  ingredients:  - 2lb boneless skinless chicken breasts  - 1 yellow onion, chopped)  - 1 bag (~3 oz) sun-dried tomatoes, chopped  - 4 cloves minced garlic  - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/4 tsp pepper - 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 4 cups chicken broth  - 1 1/2 cups dry orzo  - 1/3 cup plain greek yogurt  - 4 cups spinach  - 1/4 cup grated parmesan  directions:  1. spray crockpot with avocado oil  2. add chicken breasts, garlic, onion, sun-dried tomatoes and seasonings 3. cook on high for 3-4 hours (or low for 6-7 hours)  4. shred chicken in the crockpot  5. add dry orzo and greek yogurt and stir to combine  6. cook on high for another 20-30 minutes, until orzo is soft  7. add spinach and parmesan and stir until cheese is melted  8. serve and enjoy!  recipe credit: @brooke | 90 lbs down 🥗 🙂‍↕️ #crockpot #protein #recipesoftiktok #easyrecipe #chicken

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

‘Tis the season for my most popular recipe ever!!! These rosemary & thyme brown butter Rice Krispies treats are the easy, festive holiday dessert that everyone will love.   Cook time: 20 min plus cooling Serves: 9-16, depending on how you slice ‘em 8 oz (2 sticks) salted butter 4 sprigs thyme, plus more leaves for garnish 2 sprigs rosemary 2 10-oz bags marshmallows, + 2 cups mini marshmallows 4 cups Rice Krispies cereal 4 cups corn flakes cereal 1 cup pecan pieces Flaky salt for garnish In a large, heavy-bottomed pot, melt butter over medium heat. Once melted, add in herbs and continue cooking, stirring constantly, until it begins to foam. Keep stirring until milk solids have caramelized. Remove herbs, add in marshmallows, and stir constantly until melted. Turn off the heat and add in cereals and nuts. Stir to combine. Next, stir in your mini marshmallows. Transfer mixture to a parchment lined 9x9 baking dish. Press into an even layer (I like to use a piece of parchment paper to press down since it’s still hot hot hot). Garnish with more thyme leaves and flaky sea salt. Allow to cool. Cut into squares and serve! Enjoy, enjoy, enjoy. #thanksgivingrecipes #thanksgivingdessert #easydessert #ricekrispiestreats

cheesy stuffed garlic buns 🧀🧄 recipe: dough ¾ cup warm milk (180ml) ¼ cup warm water (60ml) 3 tsp active dry yeast (9g) 1 tbsp honey ⅓ cup granulated sugar ( or brown sugar ) (67g), divided ⅓ cup salted butter, softened (76g) 2 large eggs 2 tbsp avocado oil 5 cups bread flour (600g) 1 tsp salt important flour note: if measuring with cups, spoon the flour into your measuring cup. do not scoop directly from the flour bag, as this can pack too much flour into the cup. five cups measured this way should be approximately 600g. a kitchen scale will give you the most consistent results. combine the warm milk, water, yeast, and 1 tbsp of the sugar. add the honey and let bloom for 5–10 minutes, until foamy. add the softened butter, eggs, remaining sugar, and avocado oil. mix until combined. gradually add the flour and salt, starting with about 4 cups and adding the remaining flour a little at a time. knead until smooth and stretchy. dough texture note: this dough is supposed to be VERY soft, stretchy, and tacky. don’t keep adding flour to make it less sticky. use a little avocado oil on your hands and work surface instead. transfer to a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap and a towel, and let rise somewhere warm for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size. i like putting mine in the oven with the light on. cheese filling & shaping approximately 4 oz of pepper jack and mozzarella cubes  after the dough has risen, divide into 12 portions, approximately 90g each. flatten each portion slightly, add a cube of cheese to the center, and carefully pinch the dough closed around the filling. make sure the seams are sealed well so the cheese stays inside. roll each portion into a smooth ball and arrange in a parchment-lined baking dish, seam-side down. cover with plastic wrap and a towel and let rise somewhere warm for another 30 minutes, or until noticeably puffy. egg wash 1 egg yolk 3 tbsp heavy cream whisk together and gently brush over the tops of the buns before baking. baking bake at 350°F for approximately 25–30 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. let rest for about 5 minutes before serving. optional garlic butter topping 4 tbsp salted melted  butter  2-3 cloves garlic, minced  1 tbsp parsley  melted butter and mix in parsley and garlic. spread over baked rolls & enjoyyy!    #cheese #bread #garlicbread #recipe #baking

Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. ENJOY! . . . . #lowcarb #lowcarbrecipes #healthyrecipe #goodmoodfood #healthyfoodshare #whatsonmyplate

Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

🍔 VIRAL GARLIC PARMESAN CHEESEBURGERS 🧄🧀 Don’t make regular cheeseburgers again until you try them served face down in a pool of creamy garlic Parmesan sauce! 😭🔥 Ingredients For the burgers: * 1 lb ground beef (80/20) * 1 small onion, thinly sliced * Salt, pepper, garlic powder & paprika * 4 slices American cheese * 4 burger buns * Butter for toasting For the garlic Parmesan sauce: * 2 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp Italian seasoning * Salt & pepper to taste * Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Make the smash burgers: Divide beef into 4 portions. Add sliced onions to a hot skillet, place beef on top and smash into thin patties. Season generously. 2. Get those crispy edges: Sear until browned, flip and cook to 160°F. Top with American cheese and let it melt. 3. Make the sauce: Melt butter in a saucepan, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add heavy cream and seasonings. Simmer gently before stirring in Parmesan until smooth and creamy. 4. Toast your buns: Butter and toast until golden, then assemble your cheeseburgers. 5. Now for the best part! Pour a generous layer of warm garlic Parmesan sauce directly onto your serving plate. Cut each cheeseburger in half and place both halves cut side down directly into the sauce, allowing that cheesy goodness to soak into every bite. 6. Finish it off: Surround the burgers with crispy fries, garnish with parsley and serve immediately! PRO TIP: Keep extra garlic Parmesan sauce on the side because you’re going to want to dip EVERYTHING in it. 😂 #GarlicParmesanBurger #CheeseburgerRecipe #SmashBurgers #ViralRecipes #EasyDinnerIdeas

FRY BREAD TACOS This dinner took me right back to being a little kid, going to Pow Wow’s in the summer and eating fry bread. You could get it sweet with powdered sugar and honey, or savory, and fry bread tacos were one of my favorites. I remember beans on them too, but I kept mine simple because one of my kids doesn’t like beans. Ground beef, lettuce, cheese, homemade pico, and sour cream. Add hot sauce, add beans, add whatever you want. You’re the one eating it! Makes 8 fry bread tacos FRY BREAD • 3 cups all-purpose flour • 2 teaspoons baking powder • 1 teaspoon salt • Approximately 1 cup warm water, adding more as needed • Olive oil or your preferred frying oil TACO MEAT • 2 pounds ground beef • 1 medium onion, grated • 3 cloves garlic, grated • 1½ cups water • 1½ teaspoons Better Than Bouillon, any flavor you like. I used garlic. • 6 tablespoons Brooke’s Zesty Lime Taco Seasoning OR 2 packets taco seasoning TOPPINGS • Shredded lettuce • Shredded cheese • Pico de gallo • Sour cream • Hot sauce, optional 1. Mix the flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the warm water until the dough comes together. You want it soft and workable, without being crumbly or sticky. Add a little more water if it’s dry or a little flour if it’s too sticky. 2. Gently knead into a ball. Divide in half, then halve those pieces, then halve again to make 8 pieces. Flatten each piece between two sheets of parchment paper. Keep covered and let rest while you make the taco meat. 3. Brown the ground beef in a large skillet, adding the grated onion and garlic as it cooks. Cook until the beef is browned and the onion and garlic are tender. Drain excess grease if needed. 4. Stir in the water, Better Than Bouillon, and taco seasoning. Simmer uncovered until the excess liquid cooks off and the meat is nice and saucy without being watery. 5. Add enough oil to a separate skillet to generously cover the bottom with no dry spots. Heat over medium heat until a small piece of dough sizzles when added. 6. Carefully place the flattened dough in the hot oil, working in batches. Fry about 1–2 minutes per side until puffed and golden brown. When the bottom and edges are golden, flip and cook the other side. Adjust the heat as needed. 7. Drain on paper towels, then pile on the taco meat and your toppings. For my seasoning recipe, search “Brooke’s Zesty Lime Taco Seasoning” with “Cook with Brooke” or “Brooke Brown.” It’s seriously so freaking good. #tacos #recipe #familydinner #easyrecipe #frybread

The chicken dinner that has MILLIONS of views is back! 🤯 And honestly, there’s a reason this recipe has gone so viral! It’s simple, comforting, absolutely delicious, and one of those meals everyone needs in their recipe collection! Not everyone grew up learning how to cook, and that’s exactly why I love sharing easy, home-cooked meals like this! ❤️ My daughter was craving stuffing and cranberry sauce, so we basically had Thanksgiving dinner on a random Tuesday, and nobody was complaining! 😂 Recipe inspired by @allyssainthekitchen! 🍗 VIRAL BAKED CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: * Boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Olive oil * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Paprika * Italian seasoning * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cups chicken broth * Fresh thyme * Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil, add all seasonings, and toss to coat evenly. 3. Add sliced onion, chicken broth, and fresh thyme. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 5. Remove from oven and increase temperature to 450°F. 6. Remove thyme and carefully pour the cooking liquid into a bowl or measuring cup. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then whisk it into the cooking liquid to make your gravy. 7. Pour the gravy back over the chicken. 8. Return to the oven, uncovered, for another 30 minutes at 450°F, until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is beautifully browned! Serve over mashed potatoes with your favorite sides and ENJOY! If you love easy, family-friendly dinners that taste like you’ve been cooking all day, make sure you’re following along! I’ve got so many more recipes to share! Что следующее?/What’s next? #gray #mycolor #pinterest #color #sliver Серый — это нейтральный ахроматический цвет, который образуется при смешении белого и чёрного (или при равной концентрации красного, зелёного и синего в модели RGB). В переносном смысле слово означает бесцветный, будничный, неприметный, а также необразованный или неофициальный. [1, 2, out 3, 4, 5] Подробную информацию о значении и оттенках этого слова можно найти в Викисловаре. [1] Физические и цветовые свойства * Ахроматичность: у цвета нет яркого цветового тона, он находится между белым и чёрным. *  * Оттенки: от светлого серебристого до тёмного графитового и мокрого асфальта. *  * Восприятие: успокаивает нервную систему и служит отличным фоном для других ярких цветов.[1, 2, 3, 4] *  Переносные и разговорные значения     * Тусклый и пасмурный: погода, день или сумерки без солнца. *  * Бесцветный и безликий: скучные будни, рутина или ничем не примечательный человек («серая масса»). *  * Малокультурный: непросвещённый или невежественный человек. *  * Неофициальный («серый» рынок, «серая» зарплата): находящийся в тени закона. [1, 2, 3] *  Цвет — это субъективное зрительное ощущение, которое возникает, когда свет разной длины волны попадает в глаз. Five plants that separate a designed garden from a planted one. Rosemary — most people treat it as a herb. Designers use it as a structural evergreen with silver foliage, late winter bloom, and serious drought tolerance once established. Echinops — steel-blue globe thistle that holds its form into winter. Pollinators love it, it seeds around just enough, and nothing else gives you that texture. White Cloud Nepeta — all the soft billowing habit of catmint, none of the blue. Cleaner in a white or silver palette. Underused because most people don’t know it exists. Mountain Hydrangea (Hydrangea serrata) — more refined than arborescens, lacecap form, better fall color, and it actually performs in part shade without flopping. Blue Mist Fothergilla (Fothergilla gardenii ‘Blue Mist’) — blue-green foliage all season, then flame in fall. Native, compact, and genuinely beautiful. The plant that makes clients ask “what is that?” #gardendesign #landscapedesign

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

AI video editor in Claude Code: 3 free prompts, from an empty folder to a finished reel. #claudecode #videoediting #aitools #reels #claude SETUP (once) 1. Get the Claude app (claude.ai/download) and open the Code tab, not the browser. 2. Make a folder "AI Editor" with 3 folders inside: raw, references, done. 3. New chat in Code, choose Local, select the AI Editor folder. Needs a paid Claude plan. Runs on a computer, not a phone. PROMPT 1: TOOLS You're my video editor. We work in this folder: raw, references, done. Install and verify 5 tools: FFmpeg with libass (on Mac: ffmpeg-full, full path), faster-whisper for word-level subtitles, yt-dlp for references, Remotion, HyperFrames (npm package hyperframes). Check what's installed first. Official installs only (Homebrew, winget, npm/pip), Node.js 22+. Python packages go in a .venv here: pip install faster-whisper "av<19". Test each for real: burn a subtitle into a test clip, transcribe 5 seconds of audio. Show a table: tool, version, works or not. PROMPT 2: YOUR TASTE Here are reels whose editing I like: [link 1] [link 2] [link 3]. My format: [talking to camera / voiceover]. Download them with yt-dlp into references (for study only). Study each one frame by frame and by ear: pacing, shot length, pause cuts, subtitles, colors, graphics, transitions, music, the first 3 seconds. Season chicken: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika. 	2.	Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Simmer: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour sauce into skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. 	5. Millionaire shortbread 🤎 Recipe: Shortbread Ingredients 200 g butter 100 g caster sugar 300 g plain flour Caramel: 200g salted butter 3 tbsp caster sugar 4 tbsp golden syrup 397 g condensed milk (one tin) Shortbread: 200 g unsalted butter 100 g caster sugar 300 g plain flour  Caramel: 200 g unsalted butter 3 tbsp caster sugar 4 tbsp golden syrup 397 g condensed milk (one tin) Chocolate layer  250g melted milk chocolate  Method 1. Preheat the oven to 160°C fan and line a 9-inch square tin with baking paper. 2. Rub together the flour, sugar and butter until a crumbly dough forms. 3. Press the mixture firmly into the tin and bake for 20–25 minutes until pale golden. 4. In a saucepan, heat the condensed milk, butter, sugar and golden syrup over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves. 5. Increase the heat and bring to a boil. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring constantly, until the caramel thickens and turns golden. 6. Pour the caramel over the shortbread base and refrigerate for 1 hour until set. 7. Melt the milk chocolate and spread evenly over the caramel. Melt the white chocolate, drizzle over the top and swirl using a skewer. 8. Refrigerate for another 1–2 hours until the chocolate has set

This dinner is as easy as 1, 2, 3! 🎉 The formula is simple: a veg + a meat + a sauce. Once you do it this way, you'll never go back! Toss potatoes and green beans with olive oil, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Add mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and place chicken on top. Sprinkle with remaining salt and pepper. Spread about 1 tablespoon sauce over each piece of chicken and drizzle remaining sauce around chicken pieces onto veggies. Bake in the preheated oven, uncovered, until chicken is cooked through and browned on top, 50 to 60 minutes. Rotate the pan halfway through and gently toss any of the vegetables that aren’t submerged in the sauce. An instant read thermometer inserted near the center of chicken should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). 🧑‍🍳: Nicole #onepan #chicken #dinner #easyrecipes

artist and automata maker Amedeo Capelli, known as Stoccafisso Design, creates playful mechanical sculptures from wood, wire and simple mechanisms. In his recent shrimp automata, a handmade crustacean comes to life through a system of wooden gears, cams, rods and rotating parts hidden beneath the stage. Turning the crank transfers motion through the mechanism, making the shrimp’s body and limbs move in an exaggerated, almost theatrical way. Capelli’s work combines traditional automata-making, kinetic sculpture and humor. Creamy Chicken Tostones 😍 This recipe is a 10/10, and I’m already thinking about making it again next week. 😋 Ingredients:  * 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces * ½ teaspoon each salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano * Oil, for cooking the chicken and frying the plantains * 2 green plantains, peeled and cut into chunks * ⅓ red bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ green bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ white onion, sliced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 tablespoon butter * 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for topping * 1 tablespoon tomato paste * 1/2  chicken bouillon * 1½ cups heavy cream, or adjust to your preferred amount of sauce * ⅓ cup Parmesan cheese (add more if you want to) Instructions: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano. 2. Heat a little oil in a pan over high heat. Add the chicken and sear until browned and cooked through, about 5–7 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces. Remove from the pan and set aside. 3. Heat oil in a separate pan over medium-low heat. Fry the plantain chunks until tender but not too browned. Remove and flatten each piece with a tostonera or the bottom of a cup. 4. Raise the heat and fry the flattened plantains until crispy and golden. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and sprinkle with salt right away. 5. In a pan, heat a little oil and melt the butter. Add the peppers and onion and cook for about a minute. Add the garlic and cilantro and cook for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Stir in the tomato paste and chicken bouillon. Add the heavy cream and Parmesan, then stir until the sauce is smooth and creamy. 7. Add the chicken back to the pan and toss to coat. Taste and adjust the salt as needed. Finish with cilantro. 8. Spoon the creamy chicken over the tostones, or serve it on the side. Sometimes I wonder if I’m stagnating because I’m working with in certain parameters, but also I feel like in terms of craftsmanship I’m growing. I’m really starting to realize how much you gain by repeatedly doing the same motions and repeatedly using the same general concepts… making these monsters has been such a great Zen like practice. I’ve never really appreciated or understood production pottery or how you could make the same bowl or the same mug, and while this isn’t really that I am using some of the same building techniques the basic thing stays the same, and then it’s really just variables that create these characters, and I’m kind of enjoying the practice of it. #vermontartist #ceramics #scarymonster #kilnreveal

It is easy to find in shops and supermarkets in many countries. People have trusted this product for more than one hundred years. Knock Me Naked Cake 🍫 Ingredients: • 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food cake mix • 3 eggs • ½ cup vegetable oil • 1 cup water • 1 can sweetened condensed milk • 1 jar caramel sauce • 1 bag Butterfinger bits • 2 containers Cool Whip Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. 2. Prepare your cake mix using 3 eggs, ½ cup of oil and 1 cup of water. 3. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking dish and bake according to the package directions. 4. Once your cake comes out of the oven, poke holes all over the cake. 5. Pour your entire can of sweetened condensed milk over the warm cake. 6. Next, pour half a jar of caramel sauce over the cake, allowing everything to soak into the holes. 7. Sprinkle half of your Butterfinger bits over the cake. 8. Allow your cake to cool completely. 9. Spread your Cool Whip evenly over the top of the cake. 10. Drizzle caramel sauce all over the Cool Whip, then sprinkle the remaining Butterfinger bits on top. 11. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. This cake is even better after sitting in the refrigerator overnight! It’s the perfect dessert for church, family gatherings or potlucks! Enjoy! ❤️

Day two of Dolly recipes for Guilty Pleasures Week, and this one is about as easy as dinner gets. Dolly Parton’s 5-Ingredient Chicken Casserole. Save this one because you probably already have most of what you need. Ingredients: 3 cups cooked, shredded chicken 1 (10.5 oz) can cream of chicken soup 1 cup sour cream 1½ cups shredded cheddar cheese 1 sleeve Ritz crackers, crushed Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch square baking dish. 2. Mix the chicken, cream of chicken soup and sour cream. 3. Spread half the chicken mixture in the dish and top with half the cheese. 4. Add the remaining chicken mixture, then the rest of the cheese. 5. Top with the crushed Ritz crackers. 6. Bake for about 30 minutes, until hot and bubbly and the top is golden brown. 7. Let it sit for about 5 minutes before serving. My shortcut: I usually just shred a rotisserie chicken for this. If I have leftover rotisserie chicken in the fridge, even better. It makes this ridiculously easy. Save this one for an easy dinner night, and send it to somebody who loves Dolly. 🤍 #DollyPartonRecipe #ChickenCasserole #EasyDinnerIdeas #5IngredientRecipes #GuiltyPleasuresWeek

I’ve tested this recipe several times, and the results are even better than I expected! The coating is crispy and flavorful, while the chicken stays incredibly juicy and tender. It’s so easy for my toddler to enjoy, and the best part? No deep frying needed! Today, I’m making a big batch to freeze for later. Whenever we need a quick meal, I can bake them straight from frozen in a preheated oven at 440°F for about 15–20 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Here’s how I make :  I pound the chicken breasts to an even thickness and season them with salt and black pepper. For the crispy coating, I mix equal parts grated Parmesan cheese and panko breadcrumbs, then add garlic powder and paprika. Coat each chicken breast with mayonnaise, then press it into the breadcrumb mixture until fully coated. Bake until golden, crispy, and cooked through! My viral roasted chicken, Perfect for a cozy dinner or the holiday table!❤️ Its coated in cajun spices, garlic & herb butter, roasted sweet caramelized oranges, lemons and honey.  Full recipe and step-by-step instructions linked in my bio! 🔗 Ingredients Chicken * Whole chicken * Olive oil Dry Seasoning * Fine sea salt * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Dried oregano * Black pepper Cajun Garlic & Herb Butter * Unsalted butter * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Garlic powder * Fresh garlic * Lemon zest * Fresh thyme * Salt * Dijon mustard Honey Citrus Roasting Tray * Orange * Lemons * Honey * Fresh rosemary or thyme * Red onion How I Made It I spatchcocked the chicken, seasoned it with Cajun spices and coated it generously with homemade garlic & herb butter, both under and over the skin. I placed it over a bed of red onion and fresh herbs, surrounded it with orange and lemon slices and drizzled everything with honey. Then I slow-roasted it until tender and finished at a higher heat for that beautiful golden skin. Served with all those rich, buttery honey-citrus pan juices. Soo good!!
